theorems.name: Submission.dohr_lmo_density_eq_mult_ae
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (y₀ : Amb n ℓ) (r₀ : ℝ), closedBall y₀ r₀ ⊆ U → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀) < ⊤ → (∀ y ∈ V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.support ∩ closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)) → (∀ᵐ y ∂V.weight, y ∈ ball y₀ r₀ → V.HasDensity y (V.mult y)) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ ball y₀ r₀)), y ∉ V.carrier → V.HasDensity y 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
